sn22.102:1.2: The appearance here of both _rūparāga_ and _bhavarāga_ is unusual. Normally we would expect _rūparāga_ and _arūparāga_, both of which are forms of _bhavarāga_.
sn22.102:3.1: For _nicchoṭeti_ (“flail about”) see Sanskrit _kṣud_ (“shake, flail”), from which Buddhist Hybrid Sanskrit _chorayati_ (“clear away, cast off”). This, along with several other of these similes, is in [an6.53]().
sn22.102:4.1: Also at [dn1:3.73.4]() and [an6.53:7.1](), this metaphor is found at Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 4.3.36, where it refers to the separation of the self from the body at death.
sn22.102:5.1: These seven similes are applied differently at [sn41.141]()–47.
